Coding challenge · RepoTransBench v1.0

Java → Python
migration harness

A coding agent (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) translates 5 Java repositories to Python. The harness then runs each project's official tests (110 in total) on the result. Each version tests an instruction bundle or an attempt strategy and was run 3 times.

Tests passedShare of the 110 official tests that pass. All tests in invalid suites receive zero credit.
Projects fully migratedProjects where every official test passes, out of 5 per run.
RunsThe agent is not deterministic, so every version ran 3 times. The black line is the average, the dots are the single runs.

Tests passed per version. Black line: average of the runs · dots: single runs · grey band: lowest to highest run. Same model, projects and tests.

Why tests fail

Recorded failure entries from final attempts, including collection errors, grouped by their error (rules in failures.py). These are diagnostic records, not the number of unsuccessful tests.

Reasonv0v1v2v3
wrong import path
The agent's own files import each other without the src. prefix.
08261
missing dependency
The code needs a third-party package that is not installed.
15000
missing module
The test imports a file the agent never created.
20000
missing name
The test uses a class, function or constant that does not exist, usually because it was renamed (random_nano_id instead of randomNanoId).
10160428
wrong call signature
The function exists but takes different arguments.
18610
wrong result
The code runs but returns a wrong value.
141203
other exception
The code raises an error the test does not expect.
524110
Total failure records1731108012

Do the fixes hold on unseen tests?

The tests are split: 52 public tests may be shown to the agent as feedback, 58 hidden tests never are. Hidden-test gains support generalization within these projects; they do not establish performance on new repositories.

VersionTestsFirst attemptFinal
v2public (52 tests × 3 runs)6%12%
v2hidden (58 tests × 3 runs)7%15%
v3public (52 tests × 3 runs)53%90%
v3hidden (58 tests × 3 runs)51%86%
